entities.name: Pierre de Corneillan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre de Corneillan was the Grand Prior of Saint-Gilles and the 4th Grand Master of the Order of St. John of Jerusalem in Rhodes, serving from1353 to 1355. His Blazon was: "Gules on a bend argent three Cornish choughs sable".
